output.summary: Reported on-time gains began in March 2026, when the dispatcher bonus took effect. Pell Junction jumped only in July, when its bonus began, which matches bonus timing. RouteWise went live in February at two centers and in October at Northgate, so it does not explain the jump. Revisions rose fivefold, shifted to capacity reasons, came later and with less customer notice. Brightwell's receiving logs show 81% against the original date (87% a year earlier), and lateness complaints rose 35%. The 98% claim is unsubstantiated, and the campaign and bonus raise would be harmful. Suspend the claim, recompute against original dates, and re-base the incentive. The driver shortage is plausible but unproven, so the $2.1M hiring plan is premature.
